note: Canonical glaze materials. Analyses are typical oxide weight % (LOI = loss on ignition). 'variable' materials change from source to source: test tile first.

materials.name: Kaolin
synonyms: kaolin/caolín sur del río - blanco lavado

materials.name: Stoneware clay (body)
materials.note: Clay bodies vary - use the supplier's analysis if you have it.

materials.name: Wild clay (local dig)
materials.note: Variable: test tile first. Typical iron-bearing surface clay; fire a sample and, ideally, get it analysed.

materials.name: Porcelain stone (glaze stone)
synonyms: sanbao porcelain stone 三宝瓷石

materials.name: Slaked lime (calcium hydroxide)
materials.note: Variable: test tile first. Builder's lime can be dolomitic; old lime absorbs CO2 and becomes whiting-like. 100 g slaked lime gives about as much CaO as 135 g whiting.

materials.name: Quicklime (calcium oxide)
materials.note: Variable: test tile first. Caustic - slake it before use; it reacts with water and air.

materials.name: Barium carbonate
materials.note: Toxic raw material - use a mask and gloves; test barium glazes for leaching on food surfaces.

materials.name: Lead carbonate
materials.note: Highly toxic. Not recommended - choose a lead-free alternative.

materials.name: Red lead
materials.note: Highly toxic. Not recommended - choose a lead-free alternative.

materials.name: Ulexite
synonyms: ulexite turkish kutahya cinikop seramik company

materials.name: Lead-free frit (generic)
synonyms: 無鉛フリット lead-free frit (tougei shop)
materials.note: Unspecified frit - check the maker's analysis.

materials.name: Lead bisilicate frit
materials.note: Contains lead. Not for functional ware unless lab tested.

materials.name: Lead monosilicate frit
materials.note: Contains lead. Not for functional ware unless lab tested.

materials.name: Manganese dioxide
materials.note: Fumes during firing - ventilate the kiln.

materials.name: Silicon carbide
materials.note: Local reduction / crater agent - releases gas; 0.2-0.5% is typical.

materials.name: Wood ash (mixed)
materials.note: Variable: test tile first. Ash chemistry depends on the tree, the bark and how it was washed; unwashed ash is caustic (wear gloves).

materials.name: Fritta borica (boron frit, Italian)
materials.note: Generic Italian supplier frit - use the maker's analysis if given.

materials.name: Fritta alcalina (alkaline frit, Italian)
materials.note: Generic Italian supplier frit - use the maker's analysis if given.

materials.name: Fritta trasparente (clear frit, Italian)
materials.note: Supplier clear frit - check the analysis sheet.

materials.name: Fritta al piombo (lead frit)
materials.note: Contains lead. Not for functional ware unless lab tested.
